digest.top_line: PROTEUS: 5-yr BCR-FS 44%, MFS 71%, CSS 92% at 60-mo median f/u in a real-world high-risk prostate cancer benchmark cohort.
digest.tldr: Prostate is the only site today. PROTEUS gives a descriptive real-world benchmark for high-risk prostate cancer (5-yr BCR-FS 44%, MFS 71%, CSS 92%), meant to put perioperative strategies in context. It has no comparator arm. N, eligibility, treatment received and the high-risk definition are not in the source, so it sets a reference range, not a treatment effect.

sites.intro: One descriptive high-risk benchmark and no randomised readout, so the 5-yr BCR-FS of 44% is a reference point for trial design, not a comparison.

analysis_sections.label: Design
analysis_sections.body: Design not stated in source; described as a **real-world benchmark**. **Median follow-up 60 mo.**

analysis_sections.label: Endpoints
analysis_sections.body: Reported: **5-yr BCR-FS**, **5-yr MFS**, **5-yr CSS**. No primary endpoint or effect size stated.

analysis_sections.label: Discussion
analysis_sections.body: Framed as a reference point for **perioperative treatment strategies** in high-risk disease, not a test of one. Useful only once the cohort definition and treatments received are known, since those determine which trial populations it can benchmark.
